mod.name: Random Foreseer
page.title: Random Foreseer
page.description: Configure predictions for random outcomes. Some settings may require you to save and reload before they take effect.
section.general_prediction.title: General settings
section.general_prediction.description: Controls prediction availability across game modes.
toggle.singleplayer_prediction_enabled.d: When disabled, prediction results are hidden in singleplayer even if individual prediction settings are enabled.
toggle.multiplayer_prediction_enabled.de: When disabled, prediction results are hidden in multiplayer even if individual prediction settings are enabled.
toggle.fair_mode_enabled.label: Enable fair mode
toggle.fair_mode_enabled.description: When enabled, predictions are limited to information you could obtain by saving and reloading. In singleplayer, Ancient relics such as [gold]New Leaf[/gold] and [gold]Astrolabe[/gold] do not show predictions because their choices cannot be revisited by reloading. Card-generating potions likewise cannot be previewed outside combat.
toggle.show_drift_warnings.label: Show prediction drift warnings
toggle.show_drift_warnings.description: When enabled, predictions that may be shifted by side effects show a warning tooltip.
section.prediction_page_navigation.title: Detailed prediction settings
section.prediction_page_navigation.descr: Open a page to configure individual prediction features in or out of combat.
page.out_of_combat_prediction.title: Out-of-combat prediction
page.out_of_combat_prediction.descriptio: Configure prediction features outside combat, including relics, events, and rewards.
toggle.deck_transform_prediction_enabled: When enabled, hovering cards in transform selections from relics and events such as [gold]Astrolabe[/gold] and [gold]Morphic Grove[/gold] shows their predicted results. After you finish selecting cards, the confirmation popup displays the transformed cards directly.
toggle.relic_pickup_prediction_enabled.d: When enabled, hovering unclaimed relics such as [gold]Whetstone[/gold] and [gold]Orrery[/gold], as well as Ancient relic options, shows the random effects that will trigger on pickup.
toggle.event_option_prediction_enabled.d: When enabled, hovering option buttons in events such as [gold]Room Full of Cheese[/gold] and [gold]Colorful Philosophers[/gold] shows the random effects those options will trigger.
toggle.crystal_sphere_clairvoyance_enabl: When enabled, items beneath unrevealed fog become visible in the [gold]Crystal Sphere[/gold] event minigame.
slider.slippery_bridge_reroll_preview_co: Controls how many future reroll results are previewed for [gold]Slippery Bridge[/gold]'s Hold On option.
toggle.driftwood_reroll_prediction_enabl: When enabled, hovering [gold]Driftwood[/gold]'s reroll button shows the rerolled card reward.
toggle.paels_wing_sacrifice_prediction_e: When enabled, hovering [gold]Pael's Wing[/gold]'s Sacrifice button shows which relic you will receive for the sacrifice.
toggle.rest_site_prediction_enabled.desc: When enabled, hovering Rest Site options shows the rewards granted by relics such as [gold]Dream Catcher[/gold], [gold]Tiny Mailbox[/gold], and [gold]Shovel[/gold].
toggle.next_act_prediction_enabled.label: Predict the next Act's Ancient and boss
toggle.next_act_prediction_enabled.descr: When enabled, the top bar on boss reward screens shows the next Act's Ancient and boss.
page.in_combat_prediction.title: In-combat prediction
page.in_combat_prediction.description: Configure combat-related prediction features, including card and potion effects, end-turn prediction, and Frozen Eye.
section.prediction_sources.title: Prediction triggers
section.prediction_sources.description: Choose which interactions trigger predictions. The categories below control what those predictions can show.
header.card_and_potion_predictions.label: Card and potion effects
toggle.card_play_prediction_enabled.desc: When enabled, hovering cards in your Hand during combat shows predictions for their effects when played.
toggle.potion_prediction_enabled.label: Predict potion effects
toggle.potion_prediction_enabled.descrip: When enabled, hovering potions during combat shows predictions for their effects when used. [gold]Entropic Brew[/gold] also shows predictions outside combat. When fair mode is disabled, card-generating potions also show predictions outside combat.
toggle.combat_transform_prediction_enabl: When enabled, hovering cards on [gold]Entropy[/gold]'s transform selection screen shows what they will transform into.
header.end_turn_predictions.label: End-turn prediction
toggle.end_turn_prediction_enabled.label: Predict end-turn effects
toggle.end_turn_prediction_enabled.descr: When enabled, damage from Orbs and other sources at the end of the turn is predicted during the player's turn.
Controls when icons for each end-turn damage source and the cumulative damage total are shown above affected creatures.
While hovering the End Turn button
choice.end_turn_health_bar_forecast_disp: Controls when end-turn damage predictions are shown on affected creatures' health bars.
While hovering the End Turn button
header.frozen_eye_predictions.label: Frozen Eye
toggle.frozen_eye_enabled.label: Enable Frozen Eye
toggle.frozen_eye_enabled.description: When enabled, cards are shown in their actual draw order when viewing the Draw Pile during combat.
toggle.shuffle_prediction_enabled.label: Predict post-shuffle order
toggle.shuffle_prediction_enabled.descri: When enabled, the Frozen Eye Draw Pile view previews the post-shuffle draw order if you empty the Draw Pile during the current turn.
section.card_effect_prediction.title: Card effect prediction
section.card_effect_prediction.descripti: Configure which card effects are shown in combat predictions.
toggle.combat_card_generation_prediction: Shows which cards [gold]Stoke[/gold], [gold]Splash[/gold], and similar cards will generate.
toggle.card_draw_prediction_enabled.desc: Shows which cards you will draw from cards such as [gold]Reboot[/gold] and [gold]Calculated Gamble[/gold], including draws after a shuffle.
toggle.combat_card_selection_prediction_: Shows which cards [gold]Thrash[/gold], [gold]Hidden Gem[/gold], and similar cards will select, and highlights them in your Hand.
toggle.combat_orb_generation_prediction_: Shows which random Orb types [gold]Chaos[/gold] and similar cards will Channel.
section.potion_effect_prediction.title: Potion effect prediction
section.potion_effect_prediction.descrip: Configure which potion effects are shown in combat predictions.
toggle.potion_card_generation_prediction: Shows which cards [gold]Attack Potion[/gold], [gold]Skill Potion[/gold], and similar potions will generate.
toggle.potion_draw_prediction_enabled.de: Shows which cards you will draw when using potions such as [gold]Swift Potion[/gold] and [gold]Bottled Potential[/gold]. [gold]Snecko Oil[/gold] also shows the randomized Energy costs of cards in your Hand.
section.shared_prediction.title: Shared effect prediction
section.shared_prediction.description: Configure predictions for effects shared by cards and potions.
toggle.potion_generation_prediction_enab: Shows which random potions [gold]Entropic Brew[/gold] and [gold]Alchemize[/gold] will generate.
toggle.auto_play_from_draw_pile_predicti: Predict cards played from the Draw Pile
Shows which cards [gold]Havoc[/gold], [gold]Cascade[/gold], and [gold]Distilled Chaos[/gold] will play from the Draw Pile.
section.damage_prediction.title: Damage prediction
section.damage_prediction.description: Configure which damage predictions are shown and how they appear.
Shows predicted damage from cards, potions, and other sources above affected creatures and on their health bars. This is the master switch for all damage predictions, including Orb damage, random-target attacks, and end-turn damage.
toggle.orb_damage_prediction_enabled.des: Shows how much damage [gold]Lightning[/gold], [gold]Dark[/gold], and [gold]Glass[/gold] Orbs will deal.
toggle.random_target_attack_prediction_e: Shows how much damage random-target Attack cards such as [gold]Sword Boomerang[/gold] and [gold]Ricochet[/gold] will deal.
color.damage_prediction_health_bar_color: Damage prediction color on health bars
Controls the color of damage prediction segments on creature health bars.
section.experimental_features.title: Experimental features
section.experimental_features.descriptio: These features are still being tested and may produce incomplete or inaccurate results. They are disabled by default.
toggle.experimental_best_effort_card_pla: When enabled, combat prediction attempts to infer what partially supported cards will do when played and shows any resulting predictions.
toggle.experimental_chained_card_effect_: When enabled, card and potion predictions include downstream effects from cards automatically played by the source card or potion. Effects produced by the source itself, or triggered directly by it, are unaffected by this setting.
page.debug.title: Debug
page.debug.description: [red]Warning:[/red] these tools are intended only for development and testing and may alter your run. Avoid using them during normal play.
section.ancient_event_debug.title: Ancient events
section.ancient_event_debug.description: Debug tools for Ancient event pages.
toggle.ancient_event_debug_reroll_enable: Enable debug rerolls for Ancient events
When enabled, Ancient event pages show a debug Reroll button that generates a new set of options.
section.relic_pickup_debug.title: Relic pickup prediction
section.relic_pickup_debug.description: Debug tools for relic pickup prediction.
button.offer_predicted_non_ancient_relic: Available only during a run. Opens a reward screen containing the non-Ancient relics currently supported by pickup prediction.
button.open_predicted_treasure_room.desc: Available only during a run. Opens a treasure room that randomly selects either War Paint or Whetstone as the target relic.
button.open_relic_trader_pickup_test.des: Available only during a run. Gives you a Circlet, then opens a Relic Trader event where it can be traded for War Paint or Whetstone.
